description: This file contains function declarations and include guards related to MDIO (Management Data Input/Output) operations for the RALINK RT2880 Ethernet driver. It defines functions for linking adjustments, reading, writing, and port initialization in the RT2880 device driver.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_link_adjust
methods.description: Adjusts the link settings for a given port in the RT2880 MDIO interface.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_read
methods.description: Reads a specific register from the PHY using the MDIO interface.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_write
methods.description: Writes a value to a specific PHY register via the MDIO interface.

methods.name: rt2880_port_init
methods.description: Initializes a network port with device node configuration.
